headline: HNX-Index Falls More Than 13% in July, Liquidity Rises Nearly 15%
summary: The HNX-Index fell sharply in July 2026, while average daily trading value on the HNX rose above 1,000 billion dong. Foreign investors and securities firms' proprietary desks both remained net sellers.
why: The HNX is one of Vietnam's two main stock exchanges, where many small and mid-cap companies are listed, so its performance reflects local equity sentiment.
why_moved: Foreign investors and securities companies' proprietary trading were both net sellers during July, according to the report.
